releases.title: DeskBar AI v2.7.0: LAN Devices
releases.changelog:
• New LAN DEVICES app: control Home Assistant lights, switches, covers and fans, grouped by room.
• Sign in with your Home Assistant username and password (no long-lived token needed).
• Roomier sign-in keyboard with show/hide password.
• Fixes random crashes and unexpected returns to the clock (LVGL thread-safety).

releases.title: DeskBar AI v2.6.7 Firmware Release
releases.changelog:
• Automated multi-tenant telemetry and device registration guard.
• 4-Row 3-State IMU posture panel with active/inverted tracking.
• High-precision shelf inclinometer and uphill air bubble physics.
• Dynamic isometric chassis diagram in calibration wizard.
• Clock breathing interaction wake fix.
